Auto-captions: what was said vs what was pinned
================================================

Source   talk.mp4 (9.7 s, 720x1280, mono AAC 48 kHz). The voice is macOS `say -v Samantha -r 185`,
         delayed 0.4 s, with 0.6 s of silence after it.
Engine   whisper.cpp (whisper-cli, Homebrew) with ggml-base.bin, language "en", DTW word times.
         `leclap transcribe` took about 1.4 s wall time on this Mac (Apple silicon, under load).

Said      Every word you say becomes a caption. The speech is transcribed on your own machine,
          the words are pinned in the template, and the next render looks exactly the same.
Pinned    Every word you say becomes a caption, the speech is transcribed on your own machine,
          the words are pinned in the template, and the next render looks exactly the same.

Words     30 said, 30 pinned, 30 matching (case and punctuation ignored): word error rate 0 %.
          One punctuation difference: the full stop after "caption" came back as a comma.
Confidence  mean 0.927 (recorded in meta.resolved.transcripts.talk). Lowest: "the" 0.57 and
          "words" 0.58 (5.09-5.42 s), right after a pause; both are correct. No word is under the
          0.6 mean threshold of the transcript_low_confidence advisory, which is not raised.

Timing    Checked against the clip's own silences (ffmpeg silencedetect, -40 dB, >= 0.12 s): the
          word that follows each silence should start where the silence ends.

          silence in the clip      next pinned word           start error
          0.000-0.405 s (lead)     "Every"     0.40 s         -0.005 s
          2.290-2.536 s            "the"       2.54 s         +0.004 s
          4.864-5.084 s            "the"       5.09 s         +0.006 s
          6.655-6.863 s            "and"       6.86 s         -0.003 s
          9.093-9.707 s (tail)     "same." ends 9.04 s        -0.053 s (end)

          Word starts land within 10 ms of the speech onsets. Word ends are looser: "caption,"
          is pinned to end at 2.52 s although the voice stops at 2.29 s (whisper's DTW stretches
          the last word of a phrase over the pause), so the highlight can linger a little on the
          word before a pause. The next word's highlight still starts on time.

Repeatability  Transcribing the same clip again gives the same 30 words and times; only the "at"
          timestamp of the pin changes.
